[[File:Scintilla_Steel.jpg|thumb|250px|Scintilla Steel]]
'''Scintilla Steel''' was an [[asteroid field]] of [[Iron/Legends|iron]] asteroids in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. It was home to a group of rogue [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the [[Scintilla Scavenger/Legends|Scintilla Scavengers]]. The Scintilla Scavengers mined the asteroids and kept to themselves. Approaching starships were attacked on sight and dismantled.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66848&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Naboo System}}</ref>
